description: Gzip size budgets for production Web build artifacts under static/. Per-asset rules cap each matching file. aggregateRules cap the unique gzip total of a family so splitting one route or component into many smaller chunks cannot bypass the per-asset budgets (Refs #883). Initial per-asset baseline = measured gzip size * 1.10 (ceil). Aggregate already-split families use measured sum + 400 B. Tighten deliberately in follow-up tasks; do not raise budgets to hide regressions without justification.
baselineNote: Already-split aggregate families use measured zlib-9 sum + 400 B (Refs #1451). PR #1496 (Refs #1105) reseeded only the locale per-asset caps that overflowed after eleven reportRunFeedback.* keys (locale-fr/es/id/ms) and the eight extra-locale same-pattern families (ja/de/ko/fr/es/zh-TW/ms/id); each cap is current zlib-9 measured + 400 B on SHA 5a2fb65d. Defaults, matching rules, checker behavior, criticalPath, locale-extra, vendor/route families, and non-overflowing locale per-asset caps (ja/de/ko/zh-TW) are unchanged.
